issues: LOCATION: none of the sources states a municipality/region/coordinates for a project. The three annexes (Annex to C(2025)1904, C(2025)3491, C(2026)8051) give only the country; the Commission page table (embedded frames table-eu-fs-2026.html / table-noneu-fs.html, data files data-eu-fs-2026-10-08.json and data-noneu-fs-2025-10-17.json) has the columns Year, Name, Type, Promoter, Country, Strategic raw material, Factsheet; the 3-page '46 new EU strategic projects' overview PDF has Name, Main country, Type, Promoter, Raw material. Hence location=null for 105 of 106 rows. Only exception: C(2026)8051 item (14), whose official title itself reads '..., Racari city, Dambovita county' (location copied from the title). Note that the promoter's registered address in Article 2 of each decision is NOT a project location (e.g. Pure Battery Technologies Ltd. = Brisbane, Australia; Zinnwald Lithium Plc = London; Euro Manganese Inc = Vancouver) and was not used.

LOCATION (factsheets): the Commission page links one factsheet PDF per project for 59 projects (46 of the 47 projects of 2025 - none for NorthCYCLE - and all 13 non-EU projects; none for the 46 projects of 2026). Only one (GePETO) was opened: its text layer is not extractable with pdftotext (rendered image read by eye); its structured fields are Project Name, Type, Strategic Raw Material, Promoter, Country, Estimated Starting Date of Production, UNFC Classification, Website - no region/coordinates. The other 58 were not read; factsheet_url is provided per row so they can be inspected if more detail is wanted. Several project titles embed a place name (e.g. Lithium Hydroxide Converter Guben, European Lithium Refining and Recycling Hub Bitterfeld, ALE - Altmark Lithium Extraction, Second TBRC Lunen, Tankhouse Expansion Pirdop, CoNiKo ... in Kokkola, Myne Circular Metals Harderwijk, SALROM Baia de Fier, Pulawy Rare Earths Separation Plant, ReeMAP Project: Malmberget, Per Geijer and Lulea Industrial Park, Development and extraction of the Retkow-Grodziszcze Deposit...) but these are not stated as locations by the lists and were not copied into 'location'.

MATERIAL SLUGS: the lists say 'graphite (battery grade)' (not 'natural graphite') - kept as 'other:graphite (battery grade)' (19 rows) because natural vs synthetic is not stated in any of the lists. Likewise 'rare earth elements for magnets' is kept as 'other:rare earth elements for magnets' (light vs heavy not stated). Mapped to slugs: lithium/nickel/manganese '(battery grade)' -> lithium/nickel/manganese; 'boron (metallurgy grade)' -> boron; 'magnesium' and 'magnesium metal' -> magnesium; 'bauxite/alumina/aluminium' -> aluminium-bauxite; 'titanium-metal' (written with a hyphen in the 2026 annex) -> titanium-metal; 'silicon metal' -> silicon-metal. The verbatim wording is preserved in 'materials_as_stated'. Remap in one step if you prefer natural-graphite / light-rare-earths.

STAGES: the 2026 annex describes 8 projects only as 'integrated' (ALE - Altmark Lithium Extraction, EMME, European Lithium Refining and Recycling Hub Bitterfeld, Lithium de France, Pure Battery Technologies pCAM plant Europe, ReSuPLIR, Titanium alloys made in Europe, Zinnwald Lithium Project) without components. Their stages come from the Commission page table ('Integrated: Extraction and processing' / 'Integrated: Processing and recycling'), which the 2026 overview PDF confirms ('Integrated (Processing and Recycling)' etc.); noted in each row's source_ref. For 2025 integrated projects the annex gives the components itself. For C(2025)1904 items (6), (29), (38) the annex says 'integrated project consisting of ... extraction and ... processing components' -> [extraction, processing]. Substitution projects (ProHiPerSi, ReGAIN) have stages ['substitution'] and the material is the one being substituted (graphite, germanium).

MULTI-COUNTRY C(2025)1904 item (13) 'European Initiative for Strategic and Sustainable Graphite Production': annex says 'processing project in France, Namibia and Germany' without naming a main country; the Commission page table writes 'France (main location), Namibia, Germany'. Row: FR, other_countries_iso2 [NA, DE]. Namibia is a third country although the decision has scope 'eu'.

MULTI-COUNTRY C(2026)8051 item (8) 'CRM4Defence': annex says 'Italy, Poland, United Kingdom and France' (page/overview order: Italy, Poland, France, UK; the overview column is headed 'MAIN COUNTRY' but lists all four). No main country is stated; IT (first named in the annex; promoter Leonardo S.p.A. is Italian) was used, others [PL, GB, FR]. The UK part is outside the EU although the press release ip_26_2113 says all 46 projects are in 16 Member States.

MULTI-COUNTRY C(2025)3491 item (3) 'Norgraph a/s and Greenland Graphite a/s': annex says 'Norway (Norgraph a/s) and Greenland (Greenland Graphite a/s)'; the Commission page names the project 'Greenland Graphite a/s and Norgraph a/s' with Country 'Greenland and Norway' (reverse order). No main country stated; NO used (annex order), other_countries_iso2 [GL]. Greenland (overseas territory of Denmark) is the OCT in the decision.

ANNEX vs COMMISSION PAGE TABLE - materials: C(2025)1904 item (33) Portovesme CRM Hub: annex = lithium (battery grade) and manganese (battery grade); page table = lithium, nickel, cobalt, copper (completely different). Item (35) Project Fortum Hydromet: annex includes graphite (battery grade), page table omits it. Rows use the annex (legal act). All other 104 rows have identical material sets in both sources (wording differences only, e.g. 'rare earth elements for magnets' vs '... for permanent magnets').

ANNEX vs COMMISSION PAGE TABLE - promoters: C(2025)1904 item (12) EMILI: annex names 'IMERYS Ceramics France and IMERYS Lithium France' (Article 2 of the decision lists them separately as 12a processing / 12b extraction); page table names only IMERYS Ceramics France. Item (40) Romano Mine: page table promoter field is corrupted ('Lusorecursos Portugal Lithium S.A.Lithium (battery grade)'). C(2026)8051 item (29): annex spells 'Pure Batterry Technologies Ltd.' (typo; row keeps the annex spelling), page/overview 'Pure Battery Technologies Ltd.'. C(2026)8051 item (31): annex project name 'Refinis' and promoter 'Refinis recycling plant (UAB Refinis)', page/overview name 'Refinis recycling plant (UAB Refinis)' and promoter 'Refinis' (swapped). C(2025)3491 item (5) Jadar promoter is 'Rio Tinto via the local entity Rio Sava Exploration doo' (annex wording kept). Other differences are spelling/case only (OU, srl, ABENOJAR, LKAB order).

PROJECT NAMES: rows use the name as it appears in the annex sentence ('X is an ongoing ... project'); 'name_on_commission_page' holds the page-table name.
